title: Web Summit: Brasil chega com mais de 370 startups e programação intensa (DN Brasil)
what_it_says: For 2025, DN Brasil reported more than 370 Brazil-based startups and 151 participants selected by ApexBrasil (80 Southeast, 35 Northeast, 27 South, 6 North, 3 Center-West), and nearly R$94 million in deals in recent years.
